name: P13 real model acceptance
environment: Windows; user-authorized Alibaba Cloud workspace; actual external models; synthetic local input files only

protocolProbes.scope: Qwen text/tools/vision across Chat Completions, Responses, Messages; GLM and DeepSeek Chat tool proposals.

actualFiles.scope: Read, write, read back and register actual answer.txt=37 through each protocol. Chat/Messages exact test write approval by harness; Responses independent model review.

distinctFamilyTeam.scope: Three members independently produce files, dependency waits, parent inspect/accept/readback. No mid-run human message, automatic model retry or switch.

glmExistingFile.scope: Only a read/hash/replace/readback/artifact sub-result in a FAILED three-family team, not a passing team or proof of GLM new-file capability.

limitations: Original three-family new-file team failed. Clearer JSON-null instructions did not establish GLM new-file compatibility through this service Chat endpoint. Returned string "null" was refused without execution.

The supplementary existing-file team also failed: Qwen Responses join returned string "None" for a new-file version condition; refused without execution. Origin could be model output or upstream conversion; this evidence cannot distinguish.
Two-family success is one successful actual sample, not a guarantee that every request or every tool call will succeed.
The parent model inspected and abandoned missing or incorrect deliverables, preserving user-visible errors rather than claiming a complete result.
No credentials or database were copied into the delivery. All new test provider credentials were cleared; original isolated DBs remain for review.
The launcher DPAPI preflight and the fresh-profile capability preflight failures made no external model requests.
rawEvidence: Each matching *-task-traces.json.gz and *-events.json.gz is losslessly gzip-compressed original sanitized evidence. Reports are plain JSON. Original outputs remain in the distinct .test-results directories listed by their reports.
